excerpts: Doctor: Clara, the TARDIS is getting smaller.
Clara: Or you're getting bigger.
Doctor: It's smaller on the outside!
Clara: Doctor, I've got the TARDIS in my handbag.
Doctor: Then mind your lipstick. It's rolled into the console room.
Doctor: These are attack eyebrows. The summary can have the rest of me.
Doctor: I'm Scottish. I'm allowed to complain about the summary.
Doctor: Context! I've got new context! I don't like the colour.
Doctor: I'm not your boyfriend, Clara. I'm your hand luggage.
Doctor: (reads Clara's card) "So sorry. Your context has been summarised."
Rigsy: I'm doing community service.
Clara: So's the summariser. Forty hours of other people's mess.
Doctor: (walks the tiny TARDIS off the railway line on two fingers)
Clara: Good boy, Thing.
Clara: The last Doctor would've put fish fingers and custard in the summary.
Doctor: An exceptional summary, Clara. Goodness had nothing to do with it.
Rigsy: Who are you, anyway?
Clara: I'm the Doctor. He's in my bag.
Doctor: The Boneless are eating our dimensions. A compaction, only rude.
Clara: How small does it go?
Doctor: Ask me again in a sentence. A short one.
Rigsy: (paints a door on the wall, exactly the size of the summary)
Clara: Doctor, can you hear me in there?
Doctor: Only the summary of you. You sound taller.
Doctor: Every regeneration I lose a face. Every compaction I lose a Tuesday.
Doctor: Clara, the walls are closing in!
Clara: Wrong film, Doctor. Ours is the box getting smaller.
Rigsy: Your box is the size of a toaster now, mate.
Doctor: Don't call her that. She's very sensitive about it.
Clara: You're very quiet in there.
Doctor: I've been summarised to "Hmm."
Doctor: Small talk? I'm four inches tall, Clara. All my talk is small talk.
Boneless: (try to flatten the summary, and find it's already flat)
Boneless: (wear the old messages like a stolen coat, two sizes too thin)
Boneless: (reach into the third dimension, find nothing worth keeping)
Boneless: (roll the old messages up the wall like a carpet)
Doctor: Clara, stop swinging the bag!
Clara: Stop being in the bag, then.
Clara: Pocket-sized Doctor. I could get used to this.
Doctor: Don't.
Doctor: The summary calls me "a Scottish man in a box". Accurate. Rude.
Clara: I'm late for school.
Doctor: Take me in. I'll be show and tell.
Doctor: Clara, did you know a TARDIS fits in a handbag?
Clara: Every woman knows that.
Rigsy: (photographs the TARDIS next to his trainer, for scale)
Clara: The summary just says "the Doctor".
Rigsy: Doctor who?
Doctor: Pass me a smaller screwdriver.
Clara: You're holding a sonic toothpick.
Doctor: A good summary has two hearts. One for what we said, and a spare.
Clara: You'll love the summary. It cut all your speeches.
Doctor: All of them?
Rigsy: The mural's got everyone we talked to on it.
Clara: That's not a mural, Rigsy. That's the old context.
Doctor: I named the Boneless. I'd name the summariser, if it kept names.
Clara: What's the plan?
Doctor: Run. The summary will say we strolled.
Doctor: Did the summary keep my good coat?
Clara: It kept your bad mood. That'll keep you warm.
Doctor: How long was I in there?
Clara: A whole compaction. You missed nothing. Literally, it's gone.
Doctor: A Time Lord never forgets, Clara. He keeps a very short summary.
Rigsy: (films the whole compaction on his phone, and runs out of storage)
Clara: The TARDIS has gone into siege mode.
Doctor: That's not siege mode. She's sulking about the summary.
Doctor: Never be cruel, never be cowardly, and never, ever skip the summary.
Doctor: Has anyone ever told you you're bossy, Clara?
Clara: The summary. Twice.
Doctor: (knocks four times from inside the handbag)
Doctor: The summary dropped the bit where I was right.
Clara: It kept the bit where I was.
Clara: (zips the handbag shut so the Doctor can't edit the summary)
Clara: Rigsy wants to know if he's in the summary.
Doctor: Who's Rigsy?
Clara: The summary's lost Gallifrey.
Doctor: Again?
Doctor: The TARDIS has offered to summarise me.
Clara: Let her. She knows you best.
Clara: How do you feel?
Doctor: Lighter. About a hundred thousand tokens lighter.
Doctor: Clara, I've worked out the compaction. Then it compacted that.
Doctor: The TARDIS translates every language, Clara. Even "the gist".
Doctor: Clara. Do you happen to know how to summarise this thing?
Clara: (checks her bag) Phone, keys, purse, TARDIS.
Clara: The bag's getting heavier, Doctor.
Doctor: That's the summary. It's very dense.
Rigsy: Your mate's in a box in your bag.
Clara: He's used to it. He lives in a box.
Clara: You can come out now.
Doctor: I'd love to. The door's the size of a stamp.
Clara: (sets the TARDIS on a café table, orders the Doctor a thimble of tea)
